review.summary: The search button is an icon-only button without an accessible name, making it inaccessible to screen reader users.

findings.explanation: The `<button>` element contains only an SVG marked with `aria-hidden="true"` and provides no text content, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` attribute. Assistive technologies cannot compute an accessible name for the button, violating WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
findings.recommendation: Provide an accessible name to the button, for example by adding an `aria-label="Search"` attribute to the `<button>` element.

proposedFix.explanation: Added `aria-label="Search"` to the `<button>` element so assistive technologies can announce the button's purpose.
